grounds: C releases actual scarce expert capacity and validates all three teams without calling him. A builds two teams but still leaves third exposed to expert's releases, and product budgets do not themselves release his time.
Capped NPV 0.4×1+0.6×3=2.2, full NPV 0.4×2−0.6×3=−1, no launch zero. A reserve does not cure negative marginal economics; current cohort cannot be repriced later.
